capabilities: Limit the number of open Markdown tabs to a configurable maximum
Close the least recently used Markdown tab when a new tab would exceed the limit
Track tab usage by marking tabs as recently used on switching
Set the global maximum tab count in the plugin settings
problem: Obsidian lets users open unlimited tabs, which can clutter the workspace and consume resources.
summary: Tab manager that caps the number of open Markdown tabs and closes the least recently used one when the limit is reached.
